answer: Let paid work flow with a fixed current: each epoch releases only a set number of tasks, and an identity may carry only one at a time until it reaches the horizon, the delivery point downstream. Every handoff sends a signal to a public custody ledger, and a falcon check, a swift random independent verifier, confirms the exact transformation before the next carrier accepts it. Duplicated or empty handoffs break the chain and forfeit payment. A farm of clones cannot widen the flow, so a hundred identities merely split the same fixed stream, each still doing real work for its share.
